svg.text: Canonical P1 Genesis DB9 on a breadboard
TOP VIEW • USB-C UP • P1 USES J6 ONLY • 9 JUMPERS • GT_PAD=db9
POWER OFF WHILE WIRING • DB9 PIN 5 = 3.3V ONLY • NEVER HOT-PLUG
Follow the breakout's printed DB9 numbers
Do not insert a bare DB9 into the breadboard
WIRE EACH DB9 TERMINAL TO THE LISTED BREADBOARD HOLE
DB9 Function Jumper → Nano hole Nano contact
1 D0 / UP a5 → b5 J6.1 GPIO73
2 D1 / DOWN a6 → b6 J6.2 GPIO74
3 D2 / LEFT a9 → b9 J6.5 GPIO77
4 D3 / RIGHT a12 → b12 J6.8 GPIO27
6 TL / B,A a13 → b13 J6.9 GPIO28
7 TH SELECT a16 → b16 J6.12 GPIO29
9 TR / C,START a17 → b17 J6.13 GPIO30
Optional: 100nF ceramic capacitor directly across DB9 pins 5 and 8.
